## skenv config

Show the effective configuration of this machine

```
skenv config [flags]
```

### Examples

```console
$ skenv config show
$ skenv config show --json
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for config
```

* [skenv](skenv.md)	 - Install agent skills (Claude Code, Codex, pi) from a manifest in git
